name: The Ice Hole
description: A frozen lake where fishers cut holes in the ice for char and cod. The deepest water, they say, holds a fish you can see through.

discovery.message: Out on the white, you find a frozen lake marked with the scars of old fishing holes.

ice.text: The lake is frozen thick. Old holes have skinned over; you'll have to cut a new one.

choices.label: [Pick] Cut a hole in the ice.

cut.text: You swing the pick into the ice.
cut.success_text: The ice cracks, then gives. Black water wells up through a clean hole.
cut.failure_text: The ice is thick and your arms are cold. You chip a shallow dent and stop for breath.

hole.text: Black water steams faintly in the hole. Something pale turns far below.

leave.text: You leave the ice to freeze over again.
